description.value: Cantina Norte is a modern Mexican restaurant in Edgemont Village, North Vancouver, carrying forward the spirit of the neighbourhood's beloved Café Norte with house-made tortillas, bold Pacific Northwest-inflected flavours, and a full agave-forward bar program. The lively room offers both indoor and patio seating and handles everything from casual lunches to full venue buyouts for up to 120 guests. It has been voted Favourite Mexican Restaurant on the North Shore five years running (2021–2025).

address.value: 108 - 3246 Connaught Crescent, North Vancouver, BC V7R 0A7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active (copyright 2026) and provides comprehensive content confirming address, phone, and operations. OSM tags corroborate indoor/outdoor seating; the website confirms takeout availability and vegetarian/gluten-friendly menu options explicitly. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (604) 670-8226 sourced from website only and added to listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with a live website, confirmed address, and current operating presence in Edgemont Village.
